directives.title: NC-T01 continuity-ready witness can promote physical execution while strategy validity is incomplete
directives.canonicalRequirement: Physical NC-T01 requires at least one genuinely executable System2 witness with exact replay/continuity evidence and contract-required evidence complete. Continuity readiness or a non-INCOMPLETE validity label alone must not promote requiredInputsState, executionState, candidateGenerationExecutable, legitimate zero-pick, or physical independence.
directives.observedProblem: In system2/runtime/nct01_physical_receipt_v0_1.mjs, executableWitnesses requires ACCOUNTED + replay READY + continuity READY + no continuity blockers but does not require strategyValidity to be non-INCOMPLETE. requiredInputsState/executionState/candidateGenerationExecutable are then promoted from witnessSymbols.length>0. daily_shadow_orchestrator_v0_1.mjs records continuityBindingState and strategyValidity independently, so continuity READY can coexist with strategyValidity INCOMPLETE. In strategy_evaluator.mjs, matched hard invalidations are applied before missingRequiredEvidence, so strategyValidity=INVALIDATED can coexist with missing required evidence; therefore strategyValidity!==INCOMPLETE is not by itself an input-completeness proof.
